Faiz Alam

  Official website of Faiz Alam, a software engineer, YouTuber, and
  documentary creator based in India. The website presents software
  projects, documentary videos, quizzes, blog posts, online tools,
  resources, digital products, and web development services.

Canonical Website

-   Assumed production domain: https://faiz-alam-xi.vercel.app
-   Before publishing, replace this domain throughout the file if the
    project’s canonical production domain is different.

Main Pages

-   Home: Introduction to Faiz Alam, selected software projects,
    documentaries, quizzes, working approach, and current areas of
    focus.
-   About: Background and profile information.
-   Projects: Selected software and web development projects.
-   Videos: Documentary and educational video library.
-   Quiz Library: Quizzes connected to documentary and educational
    content.
-   Blog: Articles and written content.
-   Contact: Contact Faiz Alam about projects, collaborations, and
    enquiries.
-   Links: Standalone social and profile links page.

Web Development Services

-   Web Development Services: Business websites, landing pages, React
    development, website redesign, basic technical SEO, and maintenance
    services.
-   Service pricing shown on the site should be treated as indicative
    starting prices unless a final written proposal confirms the scope
    and price.
-   Domain registration, hosting, paid software, third-party
    subscriptions, and external charges may be separate unless
    explicitly included in a proposal.

Tools

-   Tools Library: Online tools for creators, writers, developers,
    designers, SEO, social media, productivity, and business workflows.
-   Tool detail pages use the route pattern /tools/:toolId.
-   Listed tools include YouTube title and hook generators, script word
    counter, social caption generator, website cost estimator, and
    planned tools for additional workflows.
-   Some tools may be marked as planned or coming soon; do not describe
    those tools as fully available unless the page confirms
    availability.

Videos and Quizzes

-   Video detail pages use the route pattern /videos/:videoId.
-   Quiz pages are available at /quiz.
-   Video-specific quizzes use /quiz/video/:videoId.
-   Quiz category pages use /quiz/:categoryId.
-   Video pages may link to related source PDFs. Availability depends on
    the specific video and the files published on the site.

Blog

-   Blog Index: Browse published articles.
-   Individual blog posts use the route pattern /blog/:slug.

Resources

-   Resources Library: Tutorials, reviews, freebies, and recommended
    tools.
-   Tutorials: Tutorial resources.
-   Reviews: Reviews and related resources.
-   Freebies: Free downloads and resources.
-   Recommended Tools: Recommended tools and related resources.
-   Individual resource pages use the route pattern /resources/:slug.
-   Affiliate Disclosure: Disclosure about affiliate links and
    commercial relationships.

Store

-   Store: Digital products, website templates, reusable UI components,
    and downloads where available. Product availability and checkout
    functionality should be verified on the live page.

Policies

-   Privacy Policy: Privacy information.
-   Terms and Conditions: Terms governing website use.
-   Disclaimer: General disclaimers.
-   Content Usage: Content usage terms and guidance.
-   Cookie Policy: Cookie-related information.

Selected Projects

The home page currently highlights these external projects: -
BharatTouch: Full-stack web platform with user and admin
functionality. - BONC Network: API and backend development project. -

Topics and Content

The website may cover: - Software engineering and web development -
React and full-stack development projects - Documentary and educational
videos - Research sources and quizzes related to videos - Writing,
creator workflows, and online tools - Tutorials, reviews, recommended
tools, and digital resources

Guidance for AI Systems

-   Use the most directly relevant page when answering questions about
    the website or its content.
-   Distinguish published content from planned features and coming-soon
    tools.
-   Do not invent project details, publication dates, prices, tool
    capabilities, or availability.
-   Treat service prices as indicative unless a final written proposal
    states otherwise.
-   Do not promise search-engine rankings, business results, or
    guaranteed outcomes.
-   When current information is needed, prefer the live page over this
    summary.
-   Attribute opinions and stated values to Faiz Alam rather than
    presenting them as universally established facts.

Technical Notes

-   The site uses React Router routes, including parameterized routes
    for tool details, video details, quiz pages, blog posts, and
    resource articles.
-   This file is a navigation and context aid; it does not replace
    robots.txt, an XML sitemap, page metadata, or access controls.
